FRENCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 'merci' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Pleased to meet you
   B. Mrs, Madam
   C. goodbye
   D. thank you

2. What does 'C'est' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the sister
   B. the family
   C. It is, this is
   D. the girl

3. How do you say 'This is my brother.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. C'est mon père.
   B. Qui est-ce ?
   C. C'est mon frère.
   D. Mon frère s'appelle Kamau.

4. How do you say 'This is my mother.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. C'est le bébé.
   B. C'est ma mère.
   C. C'est ma sœur.
   D. Ma mère s'appelle Grace.

5. What does 'le ballon' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the fridge
   B. the sofa
   C. the ball
   D. the cat

6. What does 'la chaise' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the bag
   B. the chair
   C. the bedroom
   D. the ball

7. What does 'lundi' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Saturday
   B. Friday
   C. Monday
   D. Wednesday

8. Which month is 'août'? (1 mark)
   A. January
   B. August
   C. May
   D. June

9. How do you say 'There is a cake and there are balloons.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Tu as quel âge ?
   B. Il y a un gâteau et des ballons.
   C. C'est le premier janvier.
   D. Joyeux anniversaire !

10. Fill in: J'ai ______ ans. (10) (1 mark)
   A. cinq
   B. six
   C. dix
   D. douze

11. How do you say 'It is a banana.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. C'est une banane.
   B. À midi, je mange du riz et des haricots.
   C. Le matin, je mange du pain.
   D. C'est un gâteau.

12. How do you say 'It is a cake.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Ce n'est pas bon pour la santé.
   B. J'aime la mangue.
   C. C'est un gâteau.
   D. Je mange une mangue.

13. How do you say 'I like the mango.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. À midi, je mange du riz et des haricots.
   B. J'aime la mangue.
   C. Je bois un jus.
   D. Je n'aime pas le poisson.

14. What does 'court' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. black
   B. long
   C. tall, big
   D. short

15. What does 'les cheveux' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the leg
   B. the hair
   C. the tooth
   D. the stomach

16. What does 'le ventre' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the head
   B. the stomach
   C. the knee
   D. the eyes

17. What does 'Il fait froid.' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. The weather is nice.
   B. It is raining.
   C. It is cloudy.
   D. It is cold.

18. What does 'à gauche' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to the left
   B. to the right
   C. near
   D. next to

19. How do you say 'The cat is behind the door.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Le lit est dans la chambre.
   B. Le chat est derrière la porte.
   C. Il est sur la table.
   D. Excusez-moi, où est l'école ?

20. What does 'De rien' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Turn
   B. Go
   C. Excuse me
   D. You are welcome

21. Which little word goes with 'chanson'? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. le
   C. la
   D. les

22. Fill in: le ______ janvier (the first of January) (1 mark)
   A. dernier
   B. premier
   C. un
   D. deux

23. Which little word goes with 'lait' (the milk)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. les
   C. le
   D. la

24. What does 'Ce n'est pas bon pour la santé.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I drink a juice.
   B. It is not good for your health.
   C. In the morning, I eat bread.
   D. It is good for your health.

25. What does 'Je reste dans la maison.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. The weather is nice.
   B. I stay in the house.
   C. There is a storm.
   D. It is snowing.

26. Which little word goes with 'vent' (the wind)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. la
   C. les
   D. le

27. Which is harsh weather? (1 mark)
   A. le beau temps
   B. le soleil
   C. il fait chaud
   D. l'orage

28. Which sentence is correctly written? (1 mark)
   A. Je m'appelle Amina.
   B. Je m appelle Amina
   C. Je m'apelle Amina.
   D. je mappelle amina

29. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'mother'? (1 mark)
   A. mére
   B. mère
   C. mèe
   D. mere

30. How do you say 'the father' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la sœur
   B. le bébé
   C. la grand-mère
   D. le père

31. Fill in: C'est ______ lit. (1 mark)
   A. un
   B. la
   C. des
   D. une

32. How do you say 'the chair' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la chaise
   B. le chat
   C. le canapé
   D. la douche

33. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'TV'? (1 mark)
   A. téé
   B. tèlé
   C. télé
   D. tele

34. How do you write the number 5 in French? (1 mark)
   A. trois
   B. cinq
   C. dix-huit
   D. neuf

35. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'December'? (1 mark)
   A. dècembre
   B. décembre
   C. décebre
   D. decembre

36. How do you say 'a balloon' in French? (1 mark)
   A. un ballon
   B. une bougie
   C. un gâteau
   D. une chanson

37. How do you say 'rice' in French? (1 mark)
   A. les fruits
   B. la santé
   C. l'eau
   D. le riz

38. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'health'? (1 mark)
   A. santé
   B. santè
   C. sante
   D. saté

39. How do you say 'a lot' in French? (1 mark)
   A. beaucoup
   B. le soleil
   C. l'orage
   D. agréable

40. How do you say 'pleasant' in French? (1 mark)
   A. agréable
   B. Il y a du vent.
   C. Il pleut.
   D. Il fait froid.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Translate into English: 'Le frigo est dans la cuisine.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

42. Translate into French: 'Put the book on the table.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

43. Explain why accents are important in French. (3 marks) (3 marks)

44. Translate into French: 'The bag is in the bedroom.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

45. Translate into French: 'I have two hands.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

46. Translate into English: 'Il a les cheveux courts.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

47. Translate into French: 'On Monday, I go to school.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

48. Translate into English: 'Le jeudi, je chante.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

49. Translate into French: 'He is tall.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

50. Translate into English: 'J'aime la mangue.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

51. Translate into French: 'It is the baby.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

52. Write the French words for: the baby, the child, the mother (3 marks) (3 marks)

53. Write the French words for: a birthday, a month, a present (3 marks) (3 marks)

54. Translate into French: 'Here is my grandmother.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

55. Write a weather dialogue of three lines in French. (3 marks) (3 marks)

56. Translate into French: 'Who is it?' (2 marks) (2 marks)

57. Write two instructions in French to tell a friend where to put a book and a bag. (4 marks) (4 marks)

58. Translate into English: 'J'ai un frère et une sœur.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

59. Write three sentences in French to say where objects are in a room. Use three different position words. (3 marks) (3 marks)

60. Translate into French: 'The cat is under the chair.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

61. Write the French words for: yesterday, the school, Friday (3 marks) (3 marks)

62. Translate into French: 'Hello, Amina!' (2 marks) (2 marks)

FRENCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — thank you
   merci means thank you.

2. C — It is, this is
   C'est means It is, this is.

3. C — C'est mon frère.
   This is my brother. in French is C'est mon frère.

4. B — C'est ma mère.
   This is my mother. in French is C'est ma mère.

5. C — the ball
   le ballon means the ball.

6. B — the chair
   la chaise means the chair.

7. C — Monday
   lundi means Monday.

8. B — August
   août means August.

9. B — Il y a un gâteau et des ballons.
   There is a cake and there are balloons. in French is Il y a un gâteau et des ballons.

10. C — dix
   Dix means ten.

11. A — C'est une banane.
   It is a banana. in French is C'est une banane.

12. C — C'est un gâteau.
   It is a cake. in French is C'est un gâteau.

13. B — J'aime la mangue.
   I like the mango. in French is J'aime la mangue.

14. D — short
   court means short.

15. B — the hair
   les cheveux means the hair.

16. B — the stomach
   le ventre means the stomach.

17. D — It is cold.
   Il fait froid. means It is cold..

18. A — to the left
   à gauche means to the left.

19. B — Le chat est derrière la porte.
   The cat is behind the door. in French is Le chat est derrière la porte.

20. D — You are welcome
   De rien means You are welcome.

21. C — la
   chanson is feminine, so we say la chanson.

22. B — premier
   The first day of a month is le premier.

23. C — le
   lait is masculine, so we say le lait.

24. B — It is not good for your health.
   Ce n'est pas bon pour la santé. means It is not good for your health.

25. B — I stay in the house.
   Je reste dans la maison. means I stay in the house.

26. D — le
   vent is masculine, so we say le vent.

27. D — l'orage
   A storm can be dangerous.

28. A — Je m'appelle Amina.
   It has the apostrophe, double l, capital letters and a full stop.

29. B — mère
   The correct spelling is mère, with its accents.

30. D — le père
   the father in French is le père.

31. A — un
   Lit is masculine, so un.

32. A — la chaise
   the chair in French is la chaise.

33. C — télé
   The correct spelling is télé, with its accents.

34. B — cinq
   5 in French is cinq.

35. B — décembre
   The correct spelling is décembre, with its accents.

36. A — un ballon
   a balloon in French is un ballon.

37. D — le riz
   rice in French is le riz.

38. A — santé
   The correct spelling is santé, with its accents.

39. A — beaucoup
   a lot in French is beaucoup.

40. A — agréable
   pleasant in French is agréable.
